scope.selection: 100 exact licence records absent from Refresh132 sample, selected from private/conditional club, golf, yacht, and recreation venue address clusters. Targeted access-boundary sample, not exhaustive closure audit.
rules: Current SFA licence presence is not proof of daily operation.
A club premises rule does not alone prove a particular tenant denies the public; hold removal until exact outlet admission is confirmed.
Distinguish members, member-sponsored guests, conditional access, and unrestricted walk-in access.
Do not infer closure from roster absence.

safra_faq.scope: Official FAQ says clubs are open to members and family/friends for most SAFRA-managed facilities; does not establish access policy for each tenant outlet.

safyc_bylaws.scope: By-laws require guests to be signed in and accompanied by a member in club premises/areas; tenant-specific admission not checked.

rsyc_guest_policy.scope: Official club publication says guests may not enter without member accompaniment and mentions card verification when dining at F&B outlets. Dated 2023; current operator confirmation needed.

sicc_island_bar_guest_policy.scope: Official named Island Bar page has member guest quota/policy. Applies only to named outlet, not other tenants.

sfa.scope: Exact licence/address identity cross-check from canonical export; not proof of current daily operation.
